Definition: to break through, i.e. spread or separate (oneself)
BiblicalUsage: Pârad is to break through, to spread, to separate. Abram and Lot separate, Lot journeying east and Abram dwelling in Canaan; when the Most High divides to the nations their inheritance, He sets the bounds of the people according to the number of Israel; and he that repeats a matter separates very friends.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe separation is sometimes God's own doing. He parts Abram and Lot, He bounds the nations, and a gossip parts friends — the same word, two very different hands.
